## Blake3.Managed

**Package:** `Blake3.Managed` 1.10.0 (NuGet)

**License:** Apache-2.0 (see package / upstream repository terms)

Used for digests and snapshot tagging in the engine.

## ZtSharp (vendor path only)

The vendor script downloads ZtSharp solely to extract the MIT Bouncy Castle
subset under `Crypto/External/`. ZtSharp’s own AGPL/MPL code is **not**
incorporated into BinSync.Core.
